text:
emily: heads-up — PR #3421 updates the Observability SDK snippets and the dashboard cost breakdown examples. request: quick eyeballs for compatibility with Dedicated/Private. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421
emily: main changes are: rename `trace_key` -> `trace_context`, small SDK snippet reformat, and replace legacy cost table with live widget sample.
sam: on it. quick note — the SDK param rename is breaking our existing snippet test harness (snip-test). i can patch the harness but need to confirm the new param name everywhere.
sam: failing snippet example:```python
from redwood.obsv import Tracer
tr = Tracer(trace_key="abc")
# new should be trace_context
```
jordan: i ran doc-migrator locally and hit this error when converting old dashboard examples: `KeyError: 'cost_table_v1'`
jordan: stack:```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "doc_migrator.py", line 214, in migrate
    node = mapping['cost_table_v1']
KeyError: 'cost_table_v1'
```
jordan: looks like some legacy widgets were removed in the latest dashboard schema. we should either include a compatibility shim or update all examples to the v2 widget (cost_widget).
marta: I can take the migration of dashboard examples. plan: replace cost_table_v1 with cost_widget and add a short note in migration guide. will also update the snippet tests to accept both keys for a transition window.
emily: thanks — can you also add a one-liner in the console docs about the parameter rename so Dedicated customers know to update pinned configs?
marta: yes. i'll add a short "backwards compatibility" section and a snippet showing both old/new usage.
docs-bot: PR checklist: [x] lint, [ ] snippet-tests, [x] links. leaving a comment on the PR to request snippet-tests run after patch.
sam: patch ready: changed test harness to accept `trace_context` and `trace_key` as aliases. added unit test. pushed to branch `docs/snippet-compat-3421`.
emily: awesome. can we also verify examples in Private (air-gapped) mode? I remember kube manifests reference the old widget name in the sample overlay.
jordan: I'll spin a small local Private instance and validate the dashboard sample. ETA ~2 hours.
marta: after jordan verifies, i'll open a follow-up PR to update migration guide and add a deprecation note with a 30-day window.
docs-bot: snippet-tests queued (job 8792).
deploy-bot: deploy preview for docs site is up: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-3421 — build passed.
emily: quick QA ask — someone to sanity-check the cost/latency breakdown wording? want to avoid implying SLA changes.
sam: i'll take wording pass. suggest: "unit cost and latency breakdowns reflect observed tokens per request and configured batching; SLAs unchanged."
emily: perfect. thanks all. i'll merge once snippet-tests green and jordan confirms Private validation. :thumbsup:
